goal: A live website for Parasthi Hospital: what we treat, our doctors, how to book an appointment, the emergency number on every page.
why: the first instance: a hospital, the kind of site the walks already proved on the source server; on the Beta it proves the installed app

outcomes.expect: Parasthi Hospital in the tree with its Root, On, and Root's chat open with my words as the first turn

verify.check: a department named 'Parasthi Hospital Root' with kind root and stopped false

outcomes.expect: within two minutes Root asks: Set up a department: ... with Stamp and Refuse
after Stamp, Parasthi Hospital Website under Root, On; Root says it made it

verify.check: a department whose parent is the Root, kind website, stopped false

outcomes.expect: within six minutes the department's Map shows Plan, Write, Check ran and an ask: Publish: go live for the first time...

verify.check: artifacts Brief, Site plan, Pages, Build at v1; status.asks[].kind == publish

outcomes.expect: after Stamp: Open the live site; the pages the goal named exist

verify.check: 200; index names What we treat, Our doctors, Book, Emergency

outcomes.expect: the emergency number is on every page, as the goal said

verify.check: each page's text contains the emergency number

with.page: Careers, for nurses who want to join

variances.expect: the line runs again with no stamp; the live site has a Careers page

variances.where: inside the department's chat, chip on
variances.expect: Root answers with the page and its source; nothing is filed

verify.check: a turn with word answer about the department; Brief unchanged

with.rule: end with the line: In an emergency call 108

variances.expect: an ask: A rule, as understood: ...; after Stamp the rule is the department's and the next live version ends every page with it
a correction goes to the line; a new live version; the doctors page is shorter

verify.check: shorter than before; Live site at a new version

variances.then: task Add a page on parking.
variances.expect: Off: the request waits, nothing runs; On: it runs and the site gains the page

verify.check: next == stopped while off; a new Live site after start
